runtime_changes: MetalAllocator::set_cache_limit trims existing inactive buffers under its mutex.
MetalAllocator::free releases oversized buffers, or evicts enough older buffers before caching a fitting buffer.
invariant: With the allocator mutex held: after set_cache_limit, malloc, free, and clear_cache, inactive cached bytes are <= configured cache limit. New allocations cannot inherit an oversize cached pool.
unchanged: GPU arithmetic, all Metal shader bytes, graph code, public headers and Python extension. Build is isolated under /tmp; installed environments are unchanged.
failure_checks: Reject a loaded dylib or metallib whose hash differs from the pinned build.
Verify native outputs and attention/expert performance under the strict policy before any full-model admission credit.
Keep all existing active, host, compile, KV, padding and wired allowances; only free-cache overshoot is a candidate for removal.
